# device42_auto_discovery_ipmi (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_ipmi" "example" {
  name           = "ipmi"
  server         = "hostname.domain.local"
  ip_start       = "10.0.0.1"
  ip_end         = "10.0.0.100"
  discovery_type = "redfish"
  schedule_days  = "0,1,2,3,4"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the ipmi autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).
- `server` (String) IP or FQDN of the target server.

### Optional

- `debug_level` (String) Debug level of the job.
- `discovery_type` (String) Type of discovery to run.
- `exclude_servers` (String) Comma separated list of addresses to exclude.
- `hostname_to_use` (Number) Hostname to use for the discovered devices.
- `ip_end` (String) End of the IP address range.
- `ip_start` (String) Start of the IP address range.
- `object_category` (String) Object category to assign to discovered devices.
- `overwrite_device_categories` (String) Whether to overwrite the object categories of existing devices.
- `overwrite_device_name` (String) Whether to overwrite the name of existing devices.
- `run_as_operator` (String) Whether to run discovery as operator.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach.
- `update_model_if_found` (String) Whether to update the model of devices that are found.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
